name: To Judge By The Cover
source:
Eric is a talented game developer who struggles with work and personal life because of his ADHD.

One day, on mom's advice, he decided to visit the book club located in the old municipal library, and it changed his life.

Right at the first meeting, he caught the attention of four handsome members. What is it if not fate?

 But be careful, Eric! Because each of them keeps skeletons in their closet!

[From [url=https://gronion.itch.io/to-judge-by-the-cover]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃里克（Eric）是一位才华横溢的游戏开发人员，由于患有注意力缺陷多动症（ADHD），他在工作和个人生活中遇到了困难。

有一天，在妈妈的建议下，他决定去参观位于旧市图书馆的读书俱乐部，这改变了他的生活。

第一次见面，他就引起了四位帅气成员的注意。如果不是命运又是什么？

 但要小心，埃里克！因为他们每个人的衣柜里都藏着骷髅！

[来自[url=https://gronion.itch.io/to-judge-by-the-cover]itch.io[/url]]
